profile.headline: Staff Mobile Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Mobile developer located in Charlotte, NC with a passion for continuous learning and personal development within the computing industry. Driven, inquisitive, and holds himself to a high standard in regards to quality of work. Has a proven track record of being able to get in and "hit the ground running" by learning on his feet, switching roles without loss of quality, and to rally team members to achieve the objective. 

Competent in both Android and iOS platforms, Payne is able to create, enhance, and maintain apps for the two platforms.

positions.title: Senior Mobile Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Acted as an Android Tech Lead for the 2025 Tax Season, owning a tax filing Native Experience which delivered a revenue of $71M with zero Sev0 Site Incidents.
• Single-handedly increased unit test code coverage from ~15% to 80% for the Android mobile app.
• Executed a complete cross-enterprise code migration of 143 files, which resulted in an improvement of delivery time by 50%.
• Authored and presented a Performance Strategy for Embedded Web Performance Improvements to Senior Leadership, resulting in engineering efforts that reduced the time to interactive on Android by 35%.
• Mentored and Assisted Junior Test Engineers in building an automated end-to-end test suite for 100% of P0 business cases using Appium.

positions.title: Co-Founder, Chief Technology Officer
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Launched flagship Youth Sports native iOS application within two months of company founding.
• Directed the company's technological vision, advocating for a native-first and customer-centric philosophy.
• Interfaced with the IT department of the parent NPO organization to resolve issues and offer suggestions for improvements to the legacy API.
• Presented technical solutions and the entire FICLV ecosystem to the parent NPO's President, which resulted in a partnership with the existing IT department and another technology firm. 
• Engineered Native mobile applications using Swift 5 (iOS) and Kotlin with Jetpack Compose (Android.)
• Engineered a robust Spring Boot Java API using Java, Gradle, and Apache Tomcat.
• Defined and maintained a relational data model, constructed a SQL Database for athletes, events, videos, and registrations using Azure SQL, and authored Stored Procedures for performing complex operations using T/SQL.
• Architected cloud ecosystem for the API, Database, and Blob Storage using Microsoft Azure.
• Maintained and administered the entire iOS and Android app release lifecycles via Apple's App Store and Google's Play Store.

projects.title: IoT Full Stack Application
projects.description:
An Internet of Things (IoT) Android app that communicates with "Smart Hardware" and adjusts various properties on said hardware such as brightness, temperature, and activity.

- Balanced two roles as both the Scrum Master of the team and the Lead Android Developer
- Implemented a complete social media authentication proof-of-concept utilizing Facebook, Google, and Amazon, within 3 business days of start date.
- Designed a complete Restful API with Spring 4 that served as the framework for the web services team to integrate the hardware connectivity functionality into.
- Served complete API documentation using Swagger
- Created automated Bash shell script that automated new developer workstation setup.
- Demonstrated progression to Product Owners and other director-level managers.
- Constructed proposals on which technology to use for new features in the app. Examples include RabbitMQ for messaging, and Google Cloud Messaging for Push Notifications.
- Wrote unit tests utilizing the JUnit testing framework to verify individual units of the app.
- Wrote user interface tests with Espresso, Android's built in UI testing framework
- Rewrote entire Backend (API and Database) using industry Best Practices such as Object Oriented Design, Loosely Coupled Code, xUnit Design Patterns, code-generated RESTful API documentation.
